tour.checkIn.body: The {termChampionLower} of each {termObjectiveLower} writes one on the workspace's rhythm: how it is going, how sure they are, and what changed since the last one. The ones you owe are listed under Review.
tour.checkIn.title: {termCheckIns}
tour.cycleStrip.body: While the {termCycleLower} is being planned, a strip under the top bar names its phase, what is holding it up and the days left to publish. Here on the Work Map the same line stays once it is published.
tour.cycleStrip.title: The {termCycleLower} strip
tour.review.body: {termCheckIns} due from you, the ones waiting for your acknowledgement, the blockers you own and the sessions you run, overdue first. The number beside it is what is waiting on you.
tour.review.title: Review, what you owe
tour.search.body: Press ⌘K, or Ctrl K, on any screen to jump to anything by its name or to run an action. Press ? to see every shortcut.
tour.search.title: ⌘K
tour.title: Finding your way around
tour.workMap.body: Every {termObjectiveLower} in the {termCycleLower} as one tree, with its {termKeyResultsLower} underneath and its health beside it. Select a row to open it without losing your place.
tour.workMap.title: The Work Map

weeklyFigures.noWeekClosedYet: No week has been closed yet. The first point lands when this session closes and writes its digest.

weeklyFigures.onePointPerWeek: One point per week this space held a session, oldest first. The figure is the average the digest recorded, not a second sum.
welcome.basics.name: What is this workspace called?
welcome.basics.timezoneHelp: Taken from your browser when the workspace was created. Every rhythm date is read in it.
welcome.demo.help: A believable organisation: spaces, a finished quarter with scores, an active cycle in phase 6, check-in history, an unhealthy KPI with a recovery objective, and blockers at different ages. Nobody is messaged. Say no and the workspace stays empty, which is the right answer if your own objectives are ready.
welcome.demo.question: Start with a worked example?
welcome.explains: Setup asks {count} questions, and every one of them already has an answer. Skip any of them and nothing is left unset.
welcome.people.help: One is enough to start. The rest is on the invitations card, and an OKR practice with one person in it is a diary.
welcome.rhythm.help: Weekly is the method's own default and what the Champion assumes. Changing it later is one field on the rhythm card.
welcome.rhythm.question: How often should the practice ask for a check-in?
welcome.template.companyHelp: Three company objectives across customers, product and operations. For a company setting its first quarter
welcome.template.help: A template is a small real quarter you can edit: a few objectives that pass the quality checks, their measures, and the first weekly session in the calendar. Skip to start empty; nothing here is a lesser path.
welcome.template.productHelp: A space, two team objectives, and a KPI tree of its own. For a product team starting inside a wider workspace
welcome.template.question: Start from a template?
welcome.template.starterHelp: One objective, its measures, a KPI, and this week's session. For a team running OKRs for the first time

workspaceState.anAdministratorCanLiftIt: A workspace administrator can lift it.
workspaceState.frozenExplained: This workspace is frozen. Nothing can be written until it is lifted, and everything already here is still readable.
workspaceState.readOnlyExplained: This workspace is read only. Everything is still readable; nothing new can be written.
